contrast_rule: Added the documented primary-colour contrast rule to adminTenantSettingsForm.ts (the one allowed logic change). The handoff's literal wording 'accents with <3:1 contrast against BOTH white and black rejected' is VACUOUS - proven by an exhaustive RGB scan: ratioVsWhite<3 requires relative luminance L>0.30 while ratioVsBlack<3 requires L<0.10, a contradiction, so nothing is ever rejected. Implemented the live, useful reading: reject unless the accent clears >=3:1 against BOTH white and black, i.e. reject when min(ratioVsWhite, ratioVsBlack) < 3. Offenders are near-white (vanishes on the light surface) and near-black (vanishes on the dark surface) extremes, not muddy mid-tones. Uses the standard WCAG relative-luminance formula (sRGB gamma expansion). Runs only AFTER isValidHexColor passes (colorInvalid takes precedence) and is skipped for an empty color. Verified the platform default accent #0E7A4A (min~3.9) and the demo #1e88e5 (min~3.68) both PASS - no broken save paths. New error i18n key: admin.tenant.validation.colorContrast (see i18n_requests). Pinned by 4 new form-module tests (asserting the returned key, not a rendered Czech string).
